text: Debugging is an important skill for every programmer. When your code does not work, the first step is identifying bugs. You need to find where the problem is and understand why it happens. Many developers use debugging tools, such as breakpoints and step-by-step execution, to examine their code closely. A systematic approach also helps: check one part at a time instead of guessing. Another useful method is logging. By adding log messages in your code, you can see what the program is doing and where it fails. With patience and good strategies, you can solve most bugs efficiently.
